questions.scenario: You are watching the ISRO Chandrayaan launch live on TV with your family. What excites you the most?

options.A: Thinking about physically assembling the rover's wheels and cameras in the cleanroom.
options.B: Understanding the complex mathematical calculations and orbital trajectory required to reach the moon.
options.C: Admiring the aerodynamic shape of the rocket's heat shield and how sleek the design looks.
options.D: Thinking about the mission director managing thousands of scientists and the tight project budget.

questions.scenario: It's Makar Sankranti (or Independence Day) and you are flying kites on the terrace. What's your main focus?

options.A: Tying the perfect 'kanni' (knots), balancing the sticks, and fixing the spool (charkhi) mechanics.
options.B: Gauging the wind speed, tension, and calculating the exact angle to cut the opponent's kite.
options.C: Crafting the most beautifully shaped, aerodynamically balanced, and colorful kite from scratch.
options.D: Buying the best kites in wholesale, organizing your friends into a team, and managing the 'kite-fighting' tournament.

questions.scenario: Your younger sibling's remote-controlled (RC) car breaks down. What do you do?

options.A: Grab a screwdriver, open it up, check the DC motor, and try to solder the loose wires back.
options.B: Analyze why the battery drained so fast and figure out the logic of the remote signal frequencies.
options.C: Remove the broken plastic shell and build a cooler, customized cardboard or 3D-printed body for it.
options.D: Negotiate a deal with your parents to get funds for spare parts, or trade parts with a friend.

questions.scenario: Your school's Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) is building a robot for the National Science Exhibition. What's your role?

options.A: I am the one wiring the sensors, attaching the wheels, and hot-gluing the metal chassis together.
options.B: I am writing the C++ code to make sure the robot follows the black line smoothly without crashing.
options.C: I am sketching out how the robot should look on the outside so it grabs the judges' attention.
options.D: I am pitching our idea to the Principal to get our lab budget approved and organizing team meetings.

questions.scenario: There is a massive power cut (load shedding) during the peak Indian summer. How do you handle it?

options.A: You try to connect a small DC motor to a 9V battery and a plastic propeller to make a mini DIY fan.
options.B: You calculate exactly how long the inverter battery will last based on the current tube light and fan load.
options.C: You fold a newspaper into an intricately designed origami fan that catches the most wind.
options.D: You organize a game of Antakshari with your siblings to keep everyone entertained until the power returns.

questions.scenario: Your friends decide to rent a drone camera to record your Sunday Gully Cricket tournament. What do you want to do?

options.A: Take the remote controller and physically pilot the drone to get the best zooming shots.
options.B: Program an automated flight path so the drone's AI automatically tracks the moving cricket ball.
options.C: Figure out a way to safely attach a better camera without ruining the drone's aerodynamic balance.
options.D: Collect the entry fees from all players, book the drone on time, and manage the tournament schedule.

questions.scenario: You are playing a mobile game like BGMI or Minecraft. What is your play style?

options.A: I focus on collecting raw materials, crafting items, and building functional machines or traps.
options.B: I constantly optimize my game settings, calculate drop distances, and figure out the game's physics.
options.C: I care mostly about customizing my character's outfits, vehicle skins, and designing epic-looking bases.
options.D: I am the squad leader—calling the shots, deciding where to land, and managing team resources.

questions.scenario: You are traveling by a domestic flight (like IndiGo or Air India) for a family vacation. What catches your attention?

options.A: Looking out the window at the mechanical flaps on the wings moving up and down during landing.
options.B: Looking at the flight tracker screen, wondering about the speed, altitude, and routing algorithms.
options.C: Noticing the interior cabin design, the nose shape of the airplane, and the sleek winglets.
options.D: Thinking about how the airline makes a profit on low-cost tickets and manages crew schedules.

questions.scenario: It's Diwali and you brought home a huge box of firecrackers. How do you approach the rocket bursting?

options.A: You carefully set up a stable launchpad in an empty bottle to ensure it fires smoothly and safely.
options.B: You analyze the trajectory, the thrust force of the gunpowder, and the peak height the rocket reaches.
options.C: You admire the colorful packaging designs and the beautiful visual patterns the sparks make in the sky.
options.D: You haggled in the wholesale market for the best price and planned the sequence of bursting for the night.

questions.scenario: Watching a sci-fi movie featuring futuristic mecha-suits (like Robot/Enthiran or Iron Man). What's your first thought?

options.A: Wondering how the hydraulic joints, servos, and actual metal gears would work in real life.
options.B: Thinking about the artificial intelligence and the thousands of lines of code controlling the suit.
options.C: Pausing the movie to admire the awesome, futuristic armor design and cool paint job.
options.D: Imagining how much funding it would take to build a startup that actually manufactures this technology.

Drone_Operator_Robotics_Technician.title: The Hands-On Hardware Hero
Drone_Operator_Robotics_Technician.primary_match_text: You love getting your hands dirty! Screwdrivers, wires, and motors are your best friends. You are a true builder at heart.
Drone_Operator_Robotics_Technician.day_in_the_life: Building custom drone frames, soldering circuits in a workshop, fixing mechanical joints, and test-flying prototype UAVs out in the field.
Drone_Operator_Robotics_Technician.alternative_match_text: You aren't just a repair person; you are the creator who physically brings metal and plastic to life.
Drone_Operator_Robotics_Technician.educational_roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th -> Pursue B.Tech in Mechatronics, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering -> Join college robotics clubs (like SAE BAJA or Robocon) -> Get a commercial drone piloting certification (DGCA approved).

Flight_Dynamics_AI_Algorithm_Engineer.title: The Brainy Code & Math Wizard
Flight_Dynamics_AI_Algorithm_Engineer.primary_match_text: Physics and Math make absolute sense to you. You love finding the logic, algorithms, and forces behind how things move.
Flight_Dynamics_AI_Algorithm_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Writing C++/Python code to make rockets fly straight, simulating wind speeds on computers, and training AI so robots can walk autonomously.
Flight_Dynamics_AI_Algorithm_Engineer.alternative_match_text: You are the genius behind the scenes who ensures the expensive hardware doesn't crash into a wall.
Flight_Dynamics_AI_Algorithm_Engineer.educational_roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th -> Prepare for JEE -> Pursue B.Tech in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or AI -> Aim for institutes like IITs or IIST -> Apply to ISRO, DRDO, or top tech companies.

Aerodynamic_Chassis_Designer.title: The Creative Tech Visionary
Aerodynamic_Chassis_Designer.primary_match_text: You have an artist's eye and an engineer's brain. You believe machines should be highly efficient AND look incredibly cool.
Aerodynamic_Chassis_Designer.day_in_the_life: Sketching futuristic drone shells, using 3D modeling software (like AutoCAD or SolidWorks), and testing shapes in a digital wind tunnel.
Aerodynamic_Chassis_Designer.alternative_match_text: You are the designer in the engineering world, beautifully blending aesthetics with hardcore aerodynamics.
Aerodynamic_Chassis_Designer.educational_roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th -> Pursue B.Tech in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering OR a B.Des (Bachelor of Design) -> Master CAD software and 3D printing -> Work with Electric Vehicle (EV) or drone manufacturing startups.

Aerospace_Project_Manager_Startup_Founde.title: The Mission Commander
Aerospace_Project_Manager_Startup_Founde.primary_match_text: You are the leader. You might not solder the robot yourself, but you definitely know how to build the team that does.
Aerospace_Project_Manager_Startup_Founde.day_in_the_life: Pitching ideas to investors, managing the mission budget, negotiating for parts, and leading a team of engineers to launch a new product.
Aerospace_Project_Manager_Startup_Founde.alternative_match_text: You are the ultimate boss who turns a cool science project into a multi-crore Indian tech startup.
Aerospace_Project_Manager_Startup_Founde.educational_roadmap: Take PCM or Commerce with Math in 11th/12th -> Pursue B.Tech or BBA -> Get an MBA in Technology Management or Entrepreneurship -> Incubate your startup idea at IIT/IIM incubation centers and raise funding.
